# Support

If you need help with agent-memory, here are the best places to ask:

## 💬 Discussions (best for "how do I..." questions)

👉 [GitHub Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/Namitjain07/agent-memory/discussions/categories/q-a)

Use Discussions for:

- "How do I configure X?"
- "Best practice for Y?"
- Architecture and design questions
- Show & tell (what you built with agent-memory)

## 🐛 Issues (only for confirmed bugs and feature requests)

👉 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Namitjain07/agent-memory/issues)

Use Issues for:

- Confirmed bugs (with a minimal reproduction)
- Concrete feature requests
- Documentation problems

**Do not** use Issues for support questions. They'll be closed and redirected to Discussions.

## 🔒 Security issues

👉 See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) — please don't open public issues for security problems.
